title: Ben Pelach or Pelekh
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Shekalim, end of chapter 2, as appointed over the wood in the Temple.[^1]

notes.text: The Mechon Mamre digital text of Tosefta Shekalim chapter 2 explicitly lists Ben Pelach over the wood. Hyman’s alternative Pelekh and end-of-chapter locator are retained. The official list supports the local office description without importing its other officials or binding the alternative spellings to one identity.
